integrity: The primary manuscript was inspected through its Laplacian, first-order Sobolev, endpoint second-order Sobolev, and local Monge–Ampère-domain criteria, together with its pure-power and iterated-log examples. The new claim follows from an explicit logarithmic-derivative computation and exact convergence tests for generalized logarithmic integrals; no numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The classification is local, assumes complex dimension at least three, and treats finite iterated-log corrections to the critical power. It does not classify arbitrary slowly varying corrections or global energy classes, and it gives no stability estimate near threshold.
title: Lexicographic iterated-log repair at the Monge–Ampère critical power
